questions.q: Which cyborg hero becomes Saitama's disciple?
questions.why: Genos, a cyborg hero, asks to learn from Saitama and lives with him.

questions.q: One-Punch Man began as what kind of work?
questions.why: ONE began it online before the manga remake.

questions.q: Despite his strength, which Hero Association class does Saitama start in?
questions.why: His poor exam results place him in C-Class, while Genos starts in S-Class.

questions.q: Which alien overlord of the Dark Matter Thieves falls to Saitama's serious punch?
questions.why: Saitama beats Boros in the Dark Matter Thieves arc.

questions.q: Saitama hails from which fictional municipality?
questions.why: Saitama is an unaffiliated hero from Z-City.

questions.q: Which company animated the first season of the One-Punch Man anime?
questions.why: Madhouse made season 1 in 2015 under Shingo Natsume, with J.C.Staff taking over for season 2.

questions.q: Saitama's daily workout includes 100 push-ups, sit-ups, squats and a run of how many kilometres?
questions.why: The routine is 100 reps each plus a 10 km run, kept up for three years.

questions.q: In what year did One-Punch Man begin online?
The remake began in 2012 on which Shueisha website?
questions.why: It has run on Tonari no Young Jump since June 2012.

questions.q: Who voices Saitama in the Japanese anime?
questions.why: Makoto Furukawa voices him in Japanese and Max Mittelman in English.
